name: Antispam Bee
notes: Turns on the time check, which stops comments sent faster than a person can type, and keeps every other spam check on. Leaves Gravatar checks off, so commenters' email hashes are not sent to Gravatar, and keeps the Dashboard and inbox quiet: no spam chart, no spam count, no email for each spam comment.

antispam_bee.time_check.label: Consider the comment time
antispam_bee.time_check.description: Treats comments sent faster than a person can type as spam. Antispam Bee warns against it with page caching.

antispam_bee.spam_ip.label: Look in the local spam database
antispam_bee.spam_ip.description: Checks for spam already caught on this site.

antispam_bee.already_commented.label: Trust approved commenters
antispam_bee.already_commented.description: Does not check people with an approved comment.

antispam_bee.bbcode_check.label: BBCode links are spam
antispam_bee.bbcode_check.description: Treats comments with BBCode links as spam.

antispam_bee.gravatar_check.label: Trust commenters with a Gravatar
antispam_bee.gravatar_check.description: Sends a hash of each commenter’s email to Gravatar to check.

antispam_bee.dashboard_chart.label: Generate statistics as a dashboard widget
antispam_bee.dashboard_chart.description: A daily spam chart on the Dashboard.

antispam_bee.dashboard_count.label: Spam counter on the dashboard
antispam_bee.dashboard_count.description: The number of spam comments caught, in At a Glance.

antispam_bee.email_notify.label: Spam-Notification by email
antispam_bee.email_notify.description: Emails admins about each spam comment.
